basic_details.job_title: DLSA Bijnor Peon (Permanent Lok Adalat) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Retired employee of the Civil Court or the Collectorate court
qualification.details: Qualification: Retired employee of the Civil Court / Collectorate court Age limit: Maximum 65 years | Other conditions: | Only retired employees of the Civil Court / Collectorate court may apply The candidate must be a citizen of India The candidate must not have more than one living spouse

exam_pattern.details: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the exam or interview.

how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application form from the DLSA Bijnor office on any working day between 10 AM and 5 PM, or download it from https://www.allahabadhighcourt.in or https://districts.ecourts.gov.in/bijnor.
Fill and sign the form; incomplete and unsigned forms will be rejected.
Attach self-signed photocopies of educational, identity, residence and character certificates and two self-signed photographs.
Put the application in a sealed envelope addressed to the Hon'ble Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court Campus, Bijnor, U.P.-246701.
Deposit it at the DLSA Bijnor office or send it by registered post by 5 PM on 30.11.2026.
important_instructions: Applications received after 30.11.2026 or sent to a wrong address will not be considered Incomplete and unsigned applications will be rejected Candidature will be cancelled if information is found false at any stage No travel expense will be paid for coming to the examination venue

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Bijnor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DLSA Bijnor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Peon.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DLSA Bijnor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Page 3 of this notice; also from the DLSA Bijnor office or the websites allahabadhighcourt.in and districts.ecourts.gov.in/bijnor) and send it to Hon'ble Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court Campus, Bijnor, U.P.-246701, by by hand at the dlsa bijnor office or by registered post, in a sealed envelope, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 7000 monthly fixed honorarium.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employee of the Civil Court or the Collectorate court.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only retired employees of the Civil Court / Collectorate court may apply. The candidate must be a citizen of India. The candidate must not have more than one living spouse.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A candidate who has been convicted by a court in a criminal case.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Educational quality. Work efficiency. Interview. Selection on the basis of educational quality, work efficiency and interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract appointment for 2 years or until the age of 65 years, whichever is completed first. No dearness allowance or any other allowance on the fixed remuneration.
